name: DC Hub
tagline: The orchestration layer for data center and energy intelligence. Call execute_plan first.
description: DC Hub: the orchestration layer for data center and energy intelligence. One server for data center and energy intelligence: facilities, colocation, power and grid, interconnection queues, electricity and gas prices, fiber and site selection. Call execute_plan first: it chains the right tools and returns one dated, cited answer. Includes the Data Center Power Index (DCPI), a daily score of where data centers can get grid power. 97 tools over remote Streamable HTTP; DCHUB_API_KEY is optional.
